name: Thelephora terrestris

ecology.substrate: nursery and forest soil around seedling roots

notes: A pioneer on seedlings whose fan or crust fruit body climbs stems. Medium-distance smooth type is reported but unchecked.

tip_speed.note: Claude's inference from the species' ecology and general knowledge, not from a measurement (2026-11-10): a fast pioneer on nursery seedlings and disturbed soil; set well above the family default

uptake_rate.note: tuning value, set to tip speed / segment length so that one feeding segment can supply about one growing tip; no measurement found
